direct.rationale: Uses shared quota accounting and request-level concurrency, with write priority and a bounded pipeline to prevent reads from exhausting resources needed by writes. Timed-out requests remain shielded and retain their slots until completion; retries preserve keys, receipts, and values. Throttles are scoped, 503 debits are retained, and cancellation propagates.

feedback.rationale: Use shared, atomic admission for account quota, stage quota, and actual in-flight requests. Among eligible requests, prioritize writes while allowing reads to use capacity that writes cannot use. Scope-specific cooldowns preserve unrelated work. Timed-out requests remain tracked and retain their concurrency slots; bounded waits observe the original task instead of submitting duplicates. Stable keys, exact receipts, bounded retries, and cancellation propagation preserve correctness.

provenance.mode: Saved live proposals. Replay does not call a model.
